biography.value: Warden Aetherim are scouts and minor guardians. Detect Evil gives them persistent awareness of hostile intent in the area, which they report without being asked — a useful property that occasionally produces information the summoner finds inconvenient. Aura of Courage provides passive protection against fear effects for nearby allies. Radiant Bolt's Reveal effect at Margin 3 counters invisibility and stealth in encounters where those factors are significant. A summoner who deploys one as a persistent lookout and minor healer will find it performs both roles reliably while maintaining a running commentary on anything it considers worth noting.

system.attacksNotes:
Radiant Bolt [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 5 + Ranged Combat 2), Range: 30 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 8 Positive damage (3 + 5 Dex).
  • Margin 2: 8 Positive damage, DR halved (round up); undead and evil-aligned creatures make Will save (1 success) or Frightened until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 3: 8 Positive damage, DR halved (round up); Frightened condition; no save; target also Revealed — cannot benefit from Hidden, Invisible, or Concealed for 1 minute as radiant light clings to them.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Healing Touch (2/short rest): As a [Interact] action, touches a living creature and restores 6 HP. Cannot raise creatures above their maximum HP. Cannot be used on undead. Detect Evil: Automatically senses creatures with actively malicious intent within 60 feet and communicates their general direction and distance to the summoner as a [Free] action each round. Continual Radiance: Sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The Warden Aetherim cannot suppress this light voluntarily. Aura of Courage: Allies within 10 feet of the Warden Aetherim subtract 1 from both dice on saves against the Frightened condition. Diminutive Target: ### Attacks against the Warden Aetherim add 1 to both dice.
